COMMENT: Behavior video only - no Miniscope. Useful for habituation sessions, camera placement, and checking that recording works before an imaging day.
COMMENT2: There is no trace display here: traces come from a Miniscope's head orientation / fluorescence ROIs or from the behavior tracker, so a webcam-only session has nothing to plot.
COMMENT_dataDirectory: Where recordings are written. './Data' is relative to the software folder so this config runs as-is; for real experiments set an absolute path with forward slashes.

BehaviorCam.COMMENT_deviceType: 'WebCam' uses the camera's default resolution; WebCam-320x240 / WebCam-640x480 / WebCam-1280x720 force one.
BehaviorCam.COMMENT_deviceID: Use 'Scan devices...' in the Devices section to find the right ID.
BehaviorCam.COMMENT_compression: Lossy compression is fine for behavior video - MJPG is the safe default, XVID gives smaller files.
